name: ovos-simple-listener
description: `ovos-simple-listener` is a lightweight alternative to `ovos-dinkum-listener`. It handles wake word detection, voice activity detection (VAD), and speech-to-text (STT) transcription for the Open Voice OS (OVOS) framework.
author: TigreGotico

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
Install `ovos-simple-listener` with pip:

pip install ovos-simple-listener
